Steroid-refractory ICI-induced pneumonit: The patient was treated with methylprednisolone and prednisolone, but showed no clinical improvement. The patient was eventually diagnosed with steroid-refractory ICI-induced pneumonitis based on the lack of response to steroid treatment.
ICI-induced pneumonitis: The patient was treated with ipilimumab and nivolumab, and after eight courses, follow-up chest CT showed new bilateral infiltrative shadows. The patient was diagnosed with grade 3 ICI-induced pneumonitis based on the clinical picture and imaging.
